remarks: Pristine townhouse located in a small, well maintained complex. Unit has its own private entrance and views of woods in the rear for privacy while enjoying your TWO decks. Updated kitchen and bathrooms, fireplace in living room with hardwood floors and sliders to private deck. Bedrooms on second level have vaulted ceilings with beautiful light, one with second deck. One full bath for each bedroom and powder room on first floor. Large, finished basement has comfortable living space, laundry, mechanical room and great storage. Two reserved parking spaces and plenty of visitor parking. Enjoy the pool this summer!
